summary: Iteration 51 — validated the three additive features shipped this session: (A) /register founding-500 seat counter, (C) AI tutor thumbs-up/down ratings backend + UI + Super Admin AI Ops surfacing, and (D) LinkedIn certificate share endpoints + Certificate page buttons. Backend suite is 8/8 green. All backend endpoints behave to spec (auth, ownership, out-of-range 400, unknown-cert 404, PNG/HTML content types, OG + Twitter meta, meta-refresh). Frontend renders the seat counter and Certificate share buttons correctly, and the Super Admin AI Ops panel shows the new Learner-ratings block + Latest-thumbs-down-reasons list. FOUND ONE HIGH-PRIORITY INTEGRATION BUG: the tutor thumbs-up/down buttons in the floating TutorDrawer send an off-by-one turn_index because assistantSeen counts the synthetic welcome bubble; every rating POST from the drawer returns 400 turn_index out of range and the buttons cannot persist. Same latent risk in TutorConversation.jsx if any caller ever prepends a welcome. Details + reproduction below.

ui_bugs.issue: Off-by-one turn_index. In both files the assistantSeen counter is incremented for EVERY assistant message and then skipped-if-welcome only for turnIndex assignment (`if (m.role === 'assistant') { assistantSeen += 1; if (m.id !== 'welcome') turnIndex = assistantSeen; }`). Because TutorDrawer seeds a synthetic welcome bubble as message[0], the first REAL assistant reply gets turnIndex=1 and testid 'tutor-rate-up-1'. But the backend session (db.chat_sessions.messages) contains only the real assistant reply at index 0. Result: POST /api/ai/tutor/rate returns 400 {'detail':'turn_index out of range'} for EVERY rating attempted from the drawer. Reproduction: register user, open Ask Aletheia, send any prompt, click thumbs-up on the reply → 400 in devtools + rating never persists across reload. Backend endpoint itself is correct (proven by test_full_rating_flow which drives it directly without a welcome bubble). Fix: only bump assistantSeen for non-welcome assistants, e.g. `if (m.id !== 'welcome') { assistantSeen += 1; turnIndex = assistantSeen; }`. This also makes the emitted testid 'tutor-rate-up-0' match the exact spec in the review request.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the off-by-one above, ratings from the drawer never persist server-side. GET /api/ai/tutor/ratings/{sid} returns {ratings: {}} on reload → thumb never re-highlights. The optimistic-update code in useTutorStream.js rolls the state back on POST failure, but many users may not notice the silent revert.

action_items: Fix off-by-one turn_index in TutorDrawer.jsx (~line 160-165) and TutorConversation.jsx (~line 33-40): move `assistantSeen += 1` inside the `if (m.id !== 'welcome')` guard so the first real assistant reply gets turnIndex=0 and testid tutor-rate-up-0 (matching the review spec). This will make drawer ratings actually persist and satisfy the '_0' testid contract.
After the fix, re-verify that reload restores the highlighted thumb (rateTurn -> POST /ai/tutor/rate 200, GET /ai/tutor/ratings/{sid} returns {'0':'up'}).

Optional: consider also asserting the 410 revoked-cert path on share-image.png in a future test — currently untested because SAMPLE-ITHR-2026-001 is intentionally never revoked. Code path exists in share_router.py L195-196.
critical_code_review_comments: share_router.py — correctly excludes _id via {_id: 0} on both find_one calls, returns proper 404/410, uses image/png content-type + LinkedIn-recommended 1200x630 dims. Good font fallback chain so a missing GreatVibes TTF does not 500 the endpoint.

share_router.py — landing page uses os.environ PUBLIC_APP_URL to build absolute og:image URL. On this preview env PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://learn.ithr.online, so the og:image resolves to the PROD hostname, not the preview backend. Scrapers hitting the preview landing will fetch the prod image URL. Consider falling back to the request's host when PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset OR using request base_url so preview and prod both work — small UX/SEO nit, not a blocker.

tutor_router.py rate_tutor_message — good UPSERT keyed on user|session|turn so re-submissions overwrite instead of duplicating; validates ownership (404) and turn range (400) correctly. Reason field capped at 500 chars via Pydantic.

command_center_router.py ai_ops — satisfaction_pct correctly returns None (surfaces as '—' in UI) when total_ratings==0. recent_negative_reasons capped at 8 to keep payload small. rating_coverage_pct uses total_msgs as denominator, which is fine but includes user messages too — if the intent is 'of assistant turns', denominator should be assistant-only. Non-blocking.
TutorDrawer.jsx + TutorConversation.jsx — see HIGH priority bug above (assistantSeen off-by-one).

Register.jsx seat counter — good: hides when remaining<=0 via the outer `seats.remaining > 0` guard; progress bar clamps min 2% width so it is visible even at claimed=0. useEffect runs once with empty deps — fine, no polling needed since backend caches 60s.

Login endpoint returns 'token' (NOT 'access_token'); admin users purge via GET /api/admin/users?q=<prefix> then DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}. Super Admin portal is at /admin (not /super-admin). To reproduce the drawer off-by-one bug: register any account -> click 'Ask Aletheia' floating button -> send any prompt -> click thumbs-up -> DevTools Network shows POST /api/ai/tutor/rate = 400 {'detail':'turn_index out of range'}.
rca of the issue: Root cause: In both TutorConversation.jsx (~L33-40) and TutorDrawer.jsx (~L160-165), the `assistantSeen` counter is incremented unconditionally for every message with role==='assistant', then a separate check `if (m.id !== 'welcome')` decides whether to assign turnIndex. Because TutorDrawer prepends a synthetic {id:'welcome', role:'assistant'} bubble, assistantSeen is already at 0 when the first real reply arrives — so the real reply gets turnIndex=1. The backend, however, stores only real messages (welcome exists only on the client), so its assistant_msgs array has just one entry at index 0. POST /api/ai/tutor/rate with turn_index=1 correctly raises HTTPException(400, 'turn_index out of range'). Mitigation (single-line): move `assistantSeen += 1` into the same block that skips the welcome bubble, so both counter and testid indices skip synthetic messages together. After the fix, testids will be tutor-rate-*-0 (matches the review spec verbatim) and ratings will persist across reload.
